scope: Blocker fix only: force-control value must match the real applied axial resultant and axial reaction with an explicit N tolerance; each converged step is tied to actual input/mesh/calculation/result content by content-derived revisions; mixed material E, reordered mesh, gauge/mesh mismatch and missing output input are rejected; displacement control is refused explicitly. No solver, UI, API, MCP, schema, CSV, save archive or progress change.

contract.curveSpecAddedField: mesh (actual reference mesh; must provide three finite coordinates per declared node)
contract.revisionSource: src/project-revision.js getProjectRevision/getPhysicalRevision only; canonical content is hashed. Caller-supplied revision strings are ignored.
contract.forceControlCheck: controlledValue must equal appliedAxisN and tensileForceN, sign included, within an absolute 1e-5 N tolerance
contract.gaugeGeometryCheck: weighted gauge point separation projected on the declared axis must equal initialGaugeLengthMm within 1e-6 mm
contract.displacementControl: explicitly refused; no successful controlledUnit=mm row is emitted

counterexample.fixture: synthetic uniform bar 10x10x40 mm, E=1e9 Pa, nu=0, A=100 mm2, L=40 mm, axis [0,0,1], real Gmsh WASM mesh and real solveElastic CPU solve at 100 N

beforeFix.method: throwaway probe outside the repository against review HEAD 68687a6

afterFix.message: Step claimed999 controlledValue does not match the applied axial force within 0.00001 N
regressionTests: controls are rejected when controlledValue is 999 N for a 100 N solve
controls are rejected when the declared sign is -100 N for a +100 N solve
displacement control is refused with no successful mm unit

otherRejectionsAfterFix.materialE2e9Pa: Step E2e9 output input differs from the curve input revision
otherRejectionsAfterFix.reorderedMeshNodesSameCount: Step reordered output mesh differs from the curve mesh revision
otherRejectionsAfterFix.gaugeLength20MmAgainst40MmMesh: Gauge initial length along the axis does not match initialGaugeLengthMm on the mesh
otherRejectionsAfterFix.missingOutputInput: Step x output input is required to derive the input revision
otherRejectionsAfterFix.displacementControl: Displacement-controlled increments are not supported: the prescribed displacement and nodal reactions cannot be verified

git diff --check.result: clean (only CRLF conversion warnings from the worktree configuration)

notVerified: A caller can still supply a self-consistent output.input/calculation that does not match the solver invocation; the hashes bind content provenance, not an execution signature.
Displacement-controlled increments are not implemented; all such steps are refused.
Nonlinear, plastic, modal, hyperelastic and maximum-only results remain unsupported.
GUI, HTTP API, MCP, CSV, static graph rendering, save/restore and case history are out of scope and unchanged.
Only the synthetic uniform-bar mesh was checked; non-uniform mesh convergence of gauge averages is untouched.
No real browser verification was performed.

notes.selfReference: This evidence intentionally contains no SHA of its own commit and no secret/token/environment dump.
